name: cavemio-status-bars
title: Status bars
description: A status page that reads at a glance: ninety days a service drawn up bar by bar, one card that glides between them, and incidents whose updates open in as they're posted.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The overall line is a heading; each service names its bars, says its status in words and describes how to read them. The day card is drawn for the eye; keyboard reading announces each day in a status region instead.
- Colour is never the only signal: every service says Operational, Degraded, Outage or Maintenance, and every day says what happened in words.
- One card serves all the bars of a service, so ninety bars carry no tooltips or listeners of their own.
- The overall dot pings only while something is wrong.
- Reduced motion draws the bars at once, moves the card without gliding and swaps sentences in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: services
props.description: – · { id, name, status ("operational" | "degraded" | "major" | "maintenance"), uptime?, days }. days are oldest first, the last one today: { date: "2026-10-14", status, minutes?, incidents? }.

props.name: incidents
props.description: – · { id, title, impact ("minor" | "major" | "maintenance"), stage, services?, updates }. updates are newest first: { id, at, stage, message }. Resolved ones fold into Past incidents.

props.name: updatedAt
props.description: – · When the data was checked; shown as "Updated 2 min ago" and kept current.

props.name: title
props.description: "Status" · Read before the overall line by screen readers.

features.title: One line says how things are
features.description: It is worked out from the services: operational, some systems degraded, major outage or maintenance. Its dot changes colour with it.

features.title: Ninety days per service
features.description: Each service draws its days up from the baseline with its uptime rolling beside it. Narrow cards show the last thirty.

features.title: One card for every bar
features.description: A single card glides from bar to bar saying what happened that day, instead of ninety tooltips.

features.title: Incidents with updates
features.description: Updates open in on top, newest first, and the stage pill morphs from Investigating to Resolved before folding into Past incidents.

features.title: Works from the keyboard
features.description: Each service’s bars are one tab stop. Arrows move a day at a time, and each day is read out.

features.title: Your own data
features.description: Everything is props, so it reads from your own checks or a status service. “Updated 2 min ago” stays current.

states.title: overall
states.description: Derived from the services: any outage reads "Major outage" (red), any degradation "Some systems degraded" (amber), maintenance "Maintenance in progress", otherwise "All systems operational" (emerald). The sentence lifts out and in through a blur; a dot pings while something is wrong.

states.title: days
states.description: On mount every bar scales up from the baseline (520ms, 5ms apart, left to right). Operational days are emerald, degraded amber, outages red, maintenance grey and days without data a thin line outline. Containers under 32rem show the last 30 days.

states.title: read
states.description: Hovering a bar dims the others to 55% and one card glides to sit over it (320ms), clamped inside the row: the date, what happened ("Degraded for 1 h 2 min") and the incidents that touched it.

states.title: keys
states.description: Each service's bars are one tab stop. Focus starts on today; arrows move a day, Home and End jump to the ends, Escape hides the card. Each day is read out as you move.

states.title: incident
states.description: Open incidents sit above the services with a coloured edge by impact. A new update fades down 6px out of a blur on top of the list; the stage pill morphs and turns green when resolved. Resolved incidents fold into "Past incidents", whose count rolls.

states.title: changes
states.description: When a service's status changes its word morphs and its colour eases over 500ms; today's bar recolours in place.
